title: Prime Minister’s Departure Statement Ahead of His Visit to the Philippines
body_text: Today, I am embarking on a visit to Manila to participate in the 23rd ASEAN-India Summit and the 21st East Asia Summit on 17 November 2026, at the invitation of President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. Our relationship with ASEAN countries is at the heart of India's Act East Policy and occupies a central place in our MAHASAGAR vision. Our ties, rooted in centuries of civilizational exchanges, have grown into a dynamic partnership spanning trade, connectivity, maritime security, technology and people-to-people relations. At the ASEAN-India Summit, I look forward to working with fellow leaders to build on the progress of our Comprehensive Strategic Partnership and give further momentum to our shared aspirations for growth, connectivity and prosperity. The East Asia Summit provides an important platform for dialogue on regional and global challenges. I look forward to exchanging views with participating leaders on strengthening peace, stability and cooperation in the Indo-Pacific. I also look forward to interacting with the vibrant Indian community in the Philippines, whose contributions strengthen the bonds of friendship between our two countries. I am confident that the visit will impart new energy to India's partnership with ASEAN and reinforce our collective commitment to a peaceful, prosperous and resilient Indo-Pacific. **** MJPS/SS/PRK
